dishes.n: Car park frozen pea smash on toast
dishes.make_ahead: Smash the peas up to 4 hours ahead and keep them covered in the fridge; toast and build just before serving

steps.text: Cook the peas in boiling salted water for 3 minutes and drain.
Smash roughly with 2 tbsp of the oil, the lemon zest and juice, most of the mint and salt and pepper.
Toast the sourdough, rub with the cut garlic and drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Spread with ricotta, pile on the peas and finish with chilli flakes, parmesan and the rest of the mint.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and chill the risotto up to 2 days ahead, or roll and crumb the balls up to 1 day ahead; fry on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time until thick and creamy.
Stir in the parmesan and peas, spread on a tray and chill until firm.
Roll into 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella, roll in flour, dip in egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Deep-fry at 180C in batches until deep golden, and drain.
Warm the passata with the salt and basil and serve with the arancini.

dishes.n: Lorenzo's limo crew meatballs and spaghetti
dishes.make_ahead: Make the meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep them together in the fridge; cook the spaghetti on the night

ingredients.item: cloves of garlic, 1 grated for the meatballs, 3 sliced for the sauce

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mince, egg, grated garlic, half the parmesan, parsley and 1 tsp of the salt. Roll into 16 balls.
Bake on an oiled tray at 200C for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile soften the onion and sliced garlic in the oil, add the passata, chilli, basil stalks and the rest of the salt and simmer 20 minutes.
Slip the meatballs into the sauce and simmer gently.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with some of the sauce, then serve with the meatballs, torn basil and the rest of the parmesan.

veg.n: Lorenzo's limo crew ricotta and mushroom meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Roll the meatballs and make the sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; bake, simmer and cook the pasta on the night

ingredients.item: cloves of garlic, 1 grated for the meatballs, 3 sliced for the sauce

steps.text: Blitz the mushrooms finely and fry in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and browned, then cool.
Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk, then mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, half the parmesan, the egg, grated garlic, parsley and 1 tsp of the salt. Roll into 16 balls and chill 30 minutes.
Soften the onion and sliced garlic in the rest of the oil, add the passata, chilli, basil stalks and the rest of the salt and simmer 15 minutes.
Bake the meatballs at 200C on an oiled tray for 15 minutes, then slip them into the sauce and simmer gently 10 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with some of the sauce, then pile into bowls with the meatballs, torn basil and the rest of the parmesan.

dishes.make_ahead: Drain the ricotta and make the filling up to 1 day ahead; fill the shells just before serving so they stay crisp

ingredients.item: icing sugar, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Drain the ricotta in a sieve in the fridge.
Beat with 80g of the icing sugar, the vanilla and orange zest until smooth, then fold in the chocolate.
Spoon into a piping bag and chill.
Pipe into the shells from both ends, dip the ends in pistachios and dust with the rest of the icing sugar.

dishes.make_ahead: Squeeze the lime up to 1 day ahead and chill everything; shake to order

steps.text: Chill 4 coupe or martini glasses.
Shake the vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry juice and lime juice hard with the ice.
Strain into the glasses and twist an orange peel over the top.

af.make_ahead: Squeeze the lime and orange juice up to 1 day ahead and chill everything; shake to order

ingredients.item: orange, juiced, peel kept for twists

steps.text: Chill 4 coupe or martini glasses.
Shake the cranberry juice, lime juice, orange juice and sugar syrup hard with the ice.
Strain into the glasses, top each with a splash of soda water and twist an orange peel over the top.

s.n: Car park frozen pea smash on toast
s.note: Smashed peas with mint, lemon and ricotta on garlic-rubbed grilled sourdough, with chilli flakes, parmesan and olive oil
s.how: Cook 500g frozen peas in boiling salted water for 3 minutes, drain and roughly smash with 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, a handful of chopped mint and salt and pepper. Grill or toast 8 slices of sourdough, rub with a cut garlic clove and drizzle with oil. Spread with 200g ricotta, pile on the peas and finish with chilli flakes, shaved parmesan and more mint.

s.note: Crumbed fried risotto balls with parmesan and peas around a mozzarella centre, with warm tomato sauce
s.how: Soften 1 small chopped onion in 30g butter, stir in 300g arborio rice, then add 1 litre hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time over 20 minutes until thick and creamy. Stir in 50g parmesan and 1/2 cup peas, spread on a tray and chill for 2 hours. Roll into 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella, roll in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in breadcrumbs. Deep-fry at 180C in batches for 4 minutes until deep golden. Warm 400g passata with a little salt and basil and serve alongside.

m.n: Lorenzo's limo crew meatballs and spaghetti
m.note: Pork and beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley in a slow tomato, garlic and basil sauce, over spaghetti with more parmesan
m.how: Soak 60g fresh breadcrumbs in 60ml milk. Mix with 500g beef and pork mince, 1 egg, 1 grated garlic clove, 30g parmesan, chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt, then roll into 16 balls. Bake at 200C on an oiled tray for 15 minutes. Meanwhile soften 1 chopped onion and 3 sliced garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil, add 1.4kg passata, 1 tsp chilli flakes, the basil stalks and 1 tsp salt and simmer 20 minutes. Slip in the meatballs and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and serve with the meatballs, torn basil and more parmesan.

w.note: Crisp cannoli shells filled with sweetened vanilla and orange ricotta, ends dipped in pistachios and dark chocolate, dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Drain 500g firm ricotta in a sieve in the fridge for 1 hour. Beat with 80g icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 orange until smooth, then fold in 50g finely chopped dark chocolate. Spoon into a piping bag and chill. Just before serving, pipe into 12 cannoli shells from both ends, dip the ends in 40g chopped pistachios and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime shaken hard and served straight up with an orange twist
d.how: Chill 4 coupe glasses. Shake 160ml vodka, 60ml orange liqueur, 240ml cranberry juice and the juice of 3 limes hard with ice. Strain into the glasses and twist a strip of orange peel over each so the oil sprays across the top.
